sources.title: README.md · nvidia/Qwen3-8B-FP8 at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The NVIDIA Qwen3-8B FP8 model is the quantized version of Alibaba's Qwen3-8B model, which is an auto-regressive language model that uses an optimized transformer architecture. For more information, please check here. The NVIDIA Qwen3-8B FP8 model is quantized with TensorRT Model Optimizer. This model is ready for commercial/non-commercial use.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 is Qwen's new model family, featuring Qwen3.8- 27B, Qwen3.8- 2.4T-A95B and Qwen3.8- Max. Qwen3.8-27B has vision and reasoning capabilities, a 256K context window, and runs locally on 17GB RAM/VRAM setups. Qwen3.8 excels at agentic coding, vision and chat tasks, and can now run via Unsloth GGUFs, NVFP4 and Unsloth Desktop. Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B is a 2.4T parameter (95B active) model with ...

sources.title: Qwen3-8B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3-8B State‑of‑the‑art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks. The Qwen3‑8B is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual base language model with 8 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.

sources.title: Qwen3-8B-FP8 — VRAM, Quants & GPU Compatibility
sources.snippet: Qwen3-8B-FP8 by nvidia — 8.19B parameter apache-2.0 model with 40K context. Minimum 5GB VRAM (Q4_K_M quantization). Compatible with 94 GPUs, cloud rental from $0.01/hr. 3 quantization options available.
